title: Hiking to Ala-Kul lake
text: **Grace’s corner** After two days of hiking I am feeling grubby, sore and grateful. Day 1 was hiking from Karakol Gorge to Sirota Yurt Camp (14km, 900m elevation gain). Day 2 was hiking past the very aqua Ala-Kul lake to Altyn-Arashan (18km, 1300m elevation gain). Day 2 we got to just shy of 4000m altitude and hiked for ten hours (I got a bit grumpy - sorry Rushan!). I am very keen for a hot meal and shower tonight :)
